node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate-order-two source-facet signature
node.closure: exact source-facet census, endpoint-involution pair profiles, and a defect-zero abstract route fence
node.statement: For an actual (m,r,delta)=(2,4,2) component stabilized by tau x 1, the 24 complete-source stars have exact census (J-J,I-I,I-J)=(10,10,4); the endpoint involution preserves I and J; and the five complete K fibers have pair degrees (4,4),(4,4),(2,2) or (4,4),(3,3),(3,3). An explicit aligned L=I abstract assignment realizes all facet containments, involution symmetry, source degrees, pole degrees, four component-color edges, and defect zero. Thus these ledgers alone do not delete the coordinate orientation; actual interpolation/coefficient equations are still required.
